title: user.merged
description: Consumed from stapel-auth. An anonymous guest account was absorbed into an existing account; the guest row ceases to exist and every CASCADE FK pointing at it would go with it. Calendar re-points the guest's owned events, their participation rows on other people's events and their availability windows onto the surviving account, so a visitor who booked or RSVP'd before signing in keeps it. Contract owned by the emitter.
